query: What concrete contamination-prevention measures will we implement (physical/temporal separation, wash-in, restricted staff crossover) and how will we detect and quantify spillover?

response.query: What concrete contamination-prevention measures will we implement (physical/temporal separation, wash-in, restricted staff crossover) and how will we detect and quantify spillover?
response.answer: We will implement physical/temporal separation, wash-in procedures, and restricted staff crossover. Spillover will be detected and quantified via regular environmental monitoring and analysis.
